video_title: Boogie Cousins CALLS OUT The Lakers For Doing LeBron DIRTY

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on players working during the pandemic
quotes.excerpt: Y'all went to work during the pandemic too, those days still counted for you.
quotes.quote: Y'all went to work during the pandemic too, those days still counted for you. They had to play a championship in the middle of a pandemic and it doesn't count for him? What's the damn difference?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye warns the Lakers about the next five years
quotes.excerpt: I promise you LA, y'all are in for an interesting five years.
quotes.quote: I promise you LA, y'all are in for an interesting five years.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Yao Ming's strength and skill
quotes.excerpt: Yao, just as strong as Shaq, buy you to one foot and then do a one foot fadeaway.
quotes.quote: Yao, just as strong as Shaq, buy you to one foot and then do a one foot fadeaway. You be like, that's worse than getting dunked on by the way.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on DeMarcus Cousins' unique skill set
quotes.excerpt: You were one of the hardest big men to guard because you didn't really have a scouting report.
quotes.quote: You were one of the hardest big men to guard because you didn't really have a scouting report. You were shockingly quick, but he's big and he's heavy and you're like, I'm like, oh fuck, all right. Well, who else is on his team? Are we double teaming him?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the Suns recruiting DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.excerpt: We start putting that belt on y'all and you go, hey, you know Shaq, Shaq wants you here.
quotes.quote: We start putting that belt on y'all and you go, hey, you know Shaq, Shaq wants you here. And so, listen, I remember as if in a weird comic show, I go, because I'm hot, right? I'm already fired up and you go, hey, Fry, you know like, Shaq wants you here. If you're not, we could use you. And I go, I need help. And I go, Shaq, look at me. Look at me. I'm kind of cooking that thing.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on his rivalry with Reggie Evans
quotes.excerpt: I kind of started a rivalry with Reggie Evans, just a silent rivalry.
quotes.quote: I kind of started a rivalry with Reggie Evans, just a silent rivalry. He was a dog. He was just working. And it just kind of happened. But we would talk trash. But for the most part, I would say my most trash talking probably was with Blake Griffin, because we were in the same conference, we played a lot. I was jealous of him.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Tim Duncan's defensive tactics
quotes.excerpt: He pulls you down on one shoulder so he can get up and block it.
quotes.quote: One thing he was infamous for is, when he's guarding the big, he pulls you down on one shoulder so he can get up and block it. That shit used to frustrate. I'm like, yo, this is a foul, yo. Like, I can't jump if he's pulling me down on one shoulder and blocking it. That's a foul, bro.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Al Jefferson's post game
quotes.excerpt: I think about guys like Al Jefferson. Al Jefferson was a bucket.
quotes.quote: I think about guys like Al Jefferson. Al Jefferson was a bucket. The one hand pump, bump fake. Man, what? All right hand, no left hand. You go spin three times, one hand pump, come. Like, Al is the nicest human being ever.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the current NBA offseason
quotes.excerpt: This has been the craziest offseason I've ever seen in the NBA.
quotes.quote: This has been the craziest offseason I've ever seen in the NBA. I've never seen this many stars on the move at once. I think this is an unbelievable draft. It could be one of those historic type draft classes, I believe. I think this was just an overall incredible offseason for the NBA in general.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on LeBron James' legacy
quotes.excerpt: I don't like the way he was treated in LA.
quotes.quote: I don't like the way he was treated in LA. And I and you know, we in this era now that you can't really speak on his behalf or is considered. Or we paid by clutch, all this goofy shit. But for the most part, you know, I grew up in the era watching Bron, like create the blueprint for for the next guys coming up. So, I think he's a legend in this game hands down. I don't think there's really much for him to prove in this game anymore. I think he's solidified in his legend, but I think as of right now, it's just about giving him what he deserves.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Shaquille O'Neal's move to the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: People forget that Shaq left Penny, left Orlando and went to LA.
quotes.quote: People forget that Shaq left Penny, left Orlando and went to LA. Oh, you going to leave the small market to go to the big market? And then all of a sudden, then Phil Jackson magically appears. Phil Jackson jumped ship and was like, you know what? I'm going to jump over here because I see these studs. So now they win three championships. And so for people to say that it was chasing rings and LeBron left the original team that he was drafted, people forget that Grant Hill and T-Mac teamed up in Orlando. And if not for Doc Rivers, Tim Duncan would have been there. Tim Duncan was on the way, that's the story.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James' accomplishments in LA
quotes.excerpt: His stretch of eight years was on par with Shaq's years.
quotes.quote: His stretch of eight years was on par with Shaq's years. Shaq's going to get a statue in OKC. It's on par with Jokic. But somehow in LA, people are like, they glad that he's gone. Did you all forget what it looked like before he got there? It was boo-boo. And so that's to me when I start to see all these people, especially Lakers and LA people, because there's Lakers fans and then there's Kobe fans. There's LeBron fans and then there's Lakers fans. And that's where the clash in my opinion. The Kobe fans wanted nothing to do with Bron being in LA wearing that purple and gold because Kobe was their guy.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the business of basketball
quotes.excerpt: In this business, it's more bad than good.
quotes.quote: In this business, it's more bad than good. And it is basically a process of where they weed out the bad till they finally find the good, which may result in a championship or a successful season. But for the most part, it's more bad than good in this league. So, it was just a dude that was in over his head, didn't really have a plan in my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on how NBA front offices operate
quotes.excerpt: If you get a GM job or a president job, you get to go through two or three coaches.
quotes.quote: If you get a GM job or a president job, you get to go through two or three coaches in a life cycle before they get rid of you. Because it's like, I'm going to take over the job. Well, this isn't my guy, so I got two years with this guy. Regardless of what he does or doesn't do, this isn't my guy. That's why when they say you're a lame duck coach. Then you bring in the next guy, and then the next guy has to do your bidding. And if he doesn't work out, you're like, uh, I'm going to fire him, got two more. So now you've been through three coaches, you ain't drafted for shit, you got rid of your draft capital, you haven't developed for shit, you have no game plan, and you're like, how do you keep a job?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins' advice for Darius Acuff Jr.
quotes.excerpt: Just embrace it, man. They, one thing about that fan base, they show so much love.
quotes.quote: Just embrace it, man. They, one thing about that fan base, they show so much love like from day one. You don't even have to score point, break a sweat, run up and down the court. The moment he was drafted by the Kings, they're going to give him their full support. So, embrace the fan base, fall in love with the city, get out there, you know, become touchable, like, you know, really, like I said, embrace the city because, you know, that's all that city really wants. They want somebody that they can lean on, give them hope, and at the end of the day, play winning basketball. And I think that's something that young kid can bring.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the importance of team culture
quotes.excerpt: If you don't have the culture, if you don't have the veterans, if you don't have the supports.
quotes.quote: If you don't have the culture, if you don't have the veterans, if you don't have the supports, if you don't have the coaches around, the shit's going to fall flat like it has in Sacramento for the last 28 out of 29 years.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the importance of team culture
quotes.excerpt: They drafted a superstar, you were a star, you were a player to build around.
quotes.quote: They drafted a superstar, you were a star, you were a player to build around, but they didn't do it over the course of time. There's not going to be a place to get a free agent, not currently constructed. They need to either trade for one like Donovan Mitchell going to Utah or going to Cleveland, or they have to draft. And they drafted you, and all of your All-Stars, your years, it's not that it was a wasted opportunity for you, but it was a wasted opportunity for the franchise. You have a centerpiece that you can build around, that you can make playoff runs, but you got to do it right. And that's the that's the thing to me when I look at Sacramento and you're just so confused.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the importance of team culture
quotes.excerpt: You had a star, they had De'Aaron Fox, they had Tyrese Haliburton, they had you.
quotes.quote: You had a star, they had De'Aaron Fox, they had Tyrese Haliburton, they had you. The Tyrese Haliburton wins rookie of the year. You can't manage to put together a team with this talent that you're drafting? That means that they're still figuring it out. That's the hardest part. I was the hardest part to watch.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on team culture and coaching
quotes.excerpt: You have to add talent to culture. When you're OKC, you've added SJ to culture.
quotes.quote: You have to add talent to culture. When you're OKC, you've added SJ to culture, and then you add pieces to that culture. When you have Boston, right? You've had Jaylen or Jaylen and and and Jayson Tatum. And you know, listen, the things happen. Listen, money happens.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Lakers' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: If it goes six or seven, I don't get to go.
quotes.quote: If it goes six or seven, I don't get to go. So it ends in five and the boys are like, they're in London. And so I literally flew home from San Antonio, dropped my kids off, got on a plane that night. Did road tripping, got on a plane and flew to Scotland. So we fly out there. I don't know, I'm not a part of the planning, I'm not a part of the trip, I'm not a part of. There's just like me being there. Shout out Kevin Love.
